dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How about talking it out with him?

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: I've tried talking, and I've tried scolding.

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: You know, he even considered leaving the village to look for some work, but then he claimed he'd miss home... or that he was sensitive to the humidity...

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: In the end, he just can't bear to leave me here alone in the village. And what am I supposed to do about that?

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: He's a good man. He's so good, he would spend our Mora on helping others.

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: I'm not saying that helping others is bad, but we need to look out for ourselves first, right?
